headline: Bring Acaia scale readings into your brew
intro: Connect an Acaia smart coffee scale to Home Assistant over Bluetooth to view its weight, battery level, timer state, and volume flow rate while brewing. Use the scale's tare and timer buttons in automations, including a brew-start sequence alongside a compatible coffee machine.
highlights: Discover a nearby scale when the Bluetooth integration is loaded, or configure it manually while the scale is on
View weight, battery level, timer state, and volume flow rate in mL/s while brewing
Use tare, reset timer, and start/stop timer buttons; Lunar, Pyxis, Pearl, and Pearl S are tested models

flow.title: From scale reading to brew automation
stages: Connect an Acaia scale over Bluetooth
View weight and volume flow rate while brewing
Use the scale's tare and timer buttons in an automation
